project.name: MAX Remote Commander
project.purpose: Provide a secure self-hosted gateway that lets LLM clients request structured capabilities on user-owned computers without exposing inbound device ports.

persistence: create-once local device and controller Ed25519 identity seeds

entry_points.name: max-chat
entry_points.purpose: Paired terminal chat/controller client using provider-neutral tool calls

constraints: agent networking must be outbound-only by default
structured capabilities are safer default than raw shell
raw shell must require explicit policy or user approval
relay bootstrap registration and controller authorities must remain distinct
relay public exposure requires TLS termination and is not yet proven
no PASS claim without executed evidence
cross-platform behavior must be tested on Linux Windows and macOS
